blur_detection.description: The receipt shows clear and legible text with good definition of characters.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed as text clarity is sufficient for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The receipt exhibits good contrast between the dark text and light background.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: No adjustment needed as contrast is adequate for text recognition.

glare_identification.description: No significant glare or reflections are visible on the receipt surface.
glare_identification.recommendation: No action required as the image has no problematic glare.

water_stains.description: No water stains or water damage are visible on the receipt.
water_stains.recommendation: No action needed as the document shows no signs of water damage.

tears_or_folds.description: The receipt shows visible wrinkles and creases throughout the paper that may affect some text readability.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: Consider flattening the receipt or using digital enhancement to improve text recognition in creased areas.

cut_off_detection.description: The receipt appears to be fully captured with no visible cut-off at the edges.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: No action needed as the entire receipt is within the frame.

missing_sections.description: All essential sections of the receipt including header, line items, and totals are present.
missing_sections.recommendation: No action needed as all typical receipt sections are captured.

obstructions.description: No fingers, shadows, or other objects obstruct any part of the receipt content.
obstructions.recommendation: No action needed as the image is free from obstructions.
